meta.titre: Application Software: classifying generic, specific and tailor-made packages and choosing between them
meta.sous_theme: Types of software, tailor-made packages and licences

sections.contenu_markdown: A pharmacist in Bamenda keeps stock records, prints invoices and writes letters to suppliers, and every one of these jobs is done by a different program. Behind them, the operating system, the printer driver and the anti-virus run without being noticed. ICT examiners ask candidates to sort these programs into their proper types, to say when it is worth paying for a program written for one customer, and to explain why a licence matters. Precise vocabulary is what earns the marks.

items: A program is a set of instructions that a computer carries out.
Hardware is the physical equipment of a computer; software is the programs that run on it.
An operating system must be present before other programs can be used.

sections.titre: System software, application software and the licences that govern them
sections.contenu_markdown:
### Two families of software
**System software** manages the hardware and provides the platform on which other programs run. It includes the **operating system** (which manages memory, the processor, files and input/output), **device drivers** (small programs that let the operating system control one particular device such as a printer) and **utility programs** (maintenance tools such as anti-virus, backup, file compression and the disk defragmenter, which rearranges the pieces of each file so that they are stored together). Language translators also belong here.

**Application software** lets the user do a job that has value in itself: write a letter, calculate a budget, keep records, draw or send mail.

### Kinds of application software
| Kind | Meaning | Examples (types) |
|---|---|---|
| Generic (general-purpose) | Can be used for many different tasks by many kinds of user; usually bought ready-made | Word processor, spreadsheet, database management system, presentation, web browser, e-mail program, desktop publishing |
| Specific (special-purpose) | Designed for one task or one kind of business | Payroll, stock control, accounting, school report cards, ticket booking |
| Tailor-made (custom or bespoke) | Written specially for one organisation to meet its exact needs | A booking system written for one hospital or one transport company |

A specific package can be bought off-the-shelf **or** be tailor-made. What makes software tailor-made is that it is written for a single customer.

### Off-the-shelf compared with tailor-made
| Point | Off-the-shelf | Tailor-made |
|---|---|---|
| Cost | Low, shared by many buyers | High, paid by one customer |
| Availability | Immediate | Weeks or months to design, write and test |
| Fit | May include unwanted features or miss some needs | Matches the exact needs |
| Reliability | Tested by many users | Fewer testers, more risk of errors at first |
| Support | From the publisher, with updates | From the developer, usually by a paid contract |

### Licences
A **software licence** is the legal permission to use a program under stated conditions (number of computers, copying, time). Reasons to buy and use licensed software: it is legal; the buyer receives technical support, updates and security patches; the copy is complete and reliable, whereas illegal copies may be damaged or carry viruses.

variantes.nom: Matching an activity to a type of software
variantes.quand_utiliser: When the question gives tasks and asks for the type (not a brand name).
variantes.contenu_markdown: Sending mail: e-mail (communication) software. Letters and reports: word processor. Budgets and calculations: spreadsheet. Storing and querying records: database management system. Posters and leaflets: desktop publishing. Building a web page: web authoring software. Writing code: a programming environment or text editor. Rearranging the parts of files on a disk: a utility program, the disk defragmenter. When the question says "type, not an example", name the category, not a product.

variantes.quand_utiliser: In multiple-choice items asking which class a program belongs to.
variantes.contenu_markdown: Ask two questions. First: does it manage the machine, or does it do the user's own job? Managing the machine means system software. Second: is it tied to one business task, or usable for many? A database management system, a spreadsheet and a word processor are generic: they can be used for any kind of data or document, so they are not tied to one task.

variantes.quand_utiliser: When the question mentions free software, trial versions or buying for many computers.
variantes.contenu_markdown: **Commercial (proprietary)**: paid for, with the publisher keeping the rights. **Shareware**: free trial, payment requested to go on using it. **Freeware**: free of charge, but the author keeps the copyright. **Open source**: the source code is available and may be studied and changed within the licence terms. **Site licence**: one price for the use of the program on many computers in one organisation.

sections.enonce_markdown:
A private school in Bafoussam has eight office computers. The bursar wants to type letters and keep budgets, and the head teacher asks for a program that prints a termly report card for each of 600 pupils, following the school's own layout.

(a) State the type of software suitable for the letters and budgets, and the kind for the report cards.

(b) The spreadsheet licence costs 30,000 FCFA per computer. A programmer quotes 1,800,000 FCFA for a tailor-made report-card system. Calculate the cost of equipping all eight computers with the spreadsheet and the difference from the quote.

(c) Give one advantage and one disadvantage of the tailor-made option.

(d) Give two reasons for buying a licensed copy rather than an illegal copy.

etapes.action: Classify each need: many possible uses, or one precise job?
etapes.justification: Letters and budgets are tasks done in every organisation; a report card with a layout specific to the school is a single, precise job.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Letters: **word processor** (generic). Budgets: **spreadsheet** (generic). Report cards: **specific** software, which can be bought ready-made or written to measure.

etapes.action: Calculate the licence cost for the generic software.
etapes.justification: A per-computer licence is multiplied by the number of computers.
The difference shows how much more the one-off tailor-made system costs than the generic package.
The extra cost buys a program that matches the school's own layout, but it takes time to write and test.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Advantage: it reproduces exactly the school's own report-card layout and rules. Disadvantage: it is expensive and takes time to design and test, and errors may appear at first.

etapes.justification: The licence gives legal rights and services that an illegal copy does not.
etapes.resultat_markdown: Licensed copies are legal and give technical support and updates; illegal copies expose the school to prosecution and may carry viruses.

sections.conclusion_markdown:
(a) Letters and budgets: generic application software (word processor and spreadsheet). Report cards: specific application software, tailor-made if the school's layout is unique.

(b) 240,000 FCFA for the spreadsheet; the quote is 1,560,000 FCFA higher.

(c) Advantage: exact fit with the school's needs. Disadvantage: higher cost and development time.

(d) Legal use, and support and updates (also protection against infected copies).

items.erreur_markdown: "A word processor is system software because it is installed together with the operating system."
items.pourquoi_faux: Where a program is installed does not decide its class. A word processor does the user's own job (writing documents), so it is application software.
items.correction_markdown: "A word processor is generic application software." System software manages the hardware.

items.erreur_markdown: "Any program made for a single purpose, such as payroll, is tailor-made."
items.pourquoi_faux: Tailor-made means written specially for one customer. A payroll package sold to many companies is specific software bought off-the-shelf.
items.correction_markdown: "Payroll software is specific software; it is tailor-made only if it was written for one organisation."

items.erreur_markdown: "An anti-virus program and a disk defragmenter are application software."
items.pourquoi_faux: They maintain and protect the computer system rather than do the user's own job, so they are utility programs.
items.correction_markdown: "They are utility programs, a kind of system software."

items.erreur_markdown: Asked for the type of software to type a letter, writing "Microsoft Word".
items.pourquoi_faux: A brand name is an example of a product, not the type. When the question asks for the type, the category is expected.
items.correction_markdown: "A word processor (generic application software)." The brand may be added as an example.

items.erreur_markdown: "You should buy licensed software because it is always cheaper than the pirated copy."
items.pourquoi_faux: A licensed copy usually costs money, and the saving is not the point. The reasons are legal and practical.
items.correction_markdown: "Licensed software is legal and comes with technical support, updates and security patches."

items.enonce_markdown:
Classify each program as system software, generic application software or specific application software.

(a) A spreadsheet.  (b) A device driver for a scanner.  (c) A stock-control package for a pharmacy.  (d) A back-up utility.  (e) A presentation program.  (f) A program that books seats on buses.
items.solution_markdown:
(a) **Generic application** (any calculation).

(b) **System software** (lets the operating system control the scanner).

(c) **Specific application** (one business task).

(d) **System software** (a utility program).

(e) **Generic application**.

(f) **Specific application** (a seat-booking task).

items.enonce_markdown:
A company needs a word processor on 15 computers. The publisher sells a single-user licence at 38,000 FCFA per computer, or a site licence for up to 20 computers at 400,000 FCFA.

(a) Calculate the cost with single-user licences.

(b) How much is saved by the site licence?

(c) From how many computers does the site licence become the cheaper option?

(d) Give one reason, other than cost, for buying a licence.
items.solution_markdown:
(a) 15 × 38,000 = **570,000 FCFA**.

(b) 570,000 − 400,000 = **170,000 FCFA** saved.

(c) 400,000 ÷ 38,000 ≈ 10.5, so 10 licences cost 380,000 FCFA (cheaper than the site licence) and 11 licences cost 418,000 FCFA (dearer). The site licence is cheaper from **11 computers**.

(d) Any one: legal use; technical support; updates and security patches; a complete, reliable copy free from viruses.

items.enonce_markdown:
A chain of 5 shops must choose software for sales records. Option A is tailor-made: 2,500,000 FCFA to develop, then 200,000 FCFA per year for maintenance. Option B is an off-the-shelf package: 90,000 FCFA per shop licence, then 60,000 FCFA per year for the support contract for the whole chain.

(a) Define tailor-made software.

(b) Calculate the total cost of each option over five years, and the difference.

(c) Give two reasons why the chain might still choose option A.
items.solution_markdown:
(a) Tailor-made software is written specially for one organisation, to meet its exact requirements.

(b) Option A: 2,500,000 + 5 × 200,000 = **3,500,000 FCFA**. Option B: 5 × 90,000 + 5 × 60,000 = 450,000 + 300,000 = **750,000 FCFA**. Difference: 3,500,000 − 750,000 = **2,750,000 FCFA** in favour of option B.

(c) Any two: it fits the chain's own procedures exactly; it can be modified when the business changes; it need not carry unwanted features; it can be built to work with equipment or records the chain already has.

items_markdown: System software manages the hardware (operating system, device drivers, utilities, language translators); application software does the user's own job.
Generic software suits many tasks (word processor, spreadsheet, database management system); specific software suits one task (payroll, stock control).
Tailor-made software is written for one customer: exact fit, but higher cost and development time. Off-the-shelf is cheaper and immediate but may not fit exactly.
Anti-virus, back-up, compression and disk defragmenter are utility programs, so system software.
When a question asks for a type, give the category (word processor, e-mail program), not a brand name.
Reasons to buy a licence: legality, technical support, updates and security patches, a complete and reliable copy.
